title: South Florida plans this week: music, pasta, fall festival
igCaption:
Music in Wynwood, pasta in Sunset Harbour, and a two-day fall festival up north.
Oct. 21 at Sunset Harbour. Oct. 23-24 in Royal Palm Beach.

Sources: Axios, USA Today, Haute Living, WPBF, Miami New Times, Miami Herald, NBC 6 South Florida, Time Out Worldwide

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #Wynwood #MiamiBeach

scenes.text: This week in South Florida, you can do almost three hundred artists, new pasta, and a two-day fall festival.

III Points is back in Wynwood this October with almost three hundred artists. Miami New Times has the set times by day and stage, and NBC 6 says the festival returns to Wynwood with what to know before you go.
scenes.caption: III Points is back in Wynwood this October with almost 300 artists. Miami New Times has the set times by day and stage, and NBC 6 says the festival returns to Wynwood with what to know before you go.

scenes.text: The Miami Herald says the music fest site will become a college campus. That leaves III Points in Wynwood this weekend with a bigger question about what comes next.
scenes.caption: The Miami Herald says the music fest site will become a college campus. That leaves III Points in Wynwood this weekend with a bigger question about what comes next.

scenes.text: A Pasta Bar Miami Beach opens in Sunset Harbour on October twenty-first. Haute Living put the opening on the calendar for Oct. 21. If you go opening night, check NEAR for who’s there too.
scenes.caption: A Pasta Bar Miami Beach opens in Sunset Harbour on Oct. 21. If you go opening night, check NEAR for who’s there too.

scenes.text: Royal Palm Beach has the Rock N' Fall Festival on October twenty-third and twenty-fourth. WPBF has the dates as Oct. 23-24.
scenes.caption: Royal Palm Beach has the Rock N' Fall Festival on Oct. 23-24.

scenes.text: Music, pasta, or the fall festival. Music, pasta, and fall festivals are full of people you pass without meeting, and NEAR is what tells you who that familiar face was. Which one would you pick this week?
